targetDisplay.note: 112 px of canonical body width (874 px) scales the 1024 canvas to about 131 px.

generation.background: Generated on black, then keyed to binary alpha. Canvas stayed 1024x1024. Frames were not cropped to their opaque bounds and were not recentered.

idle.loopSeam: The sail drops from the upright billow to the flattened rake, then the loop restarts on the upright ease. That restart is the large step.

frames.pose: Sail eased toward the prow, a little more upright than the canonical rake. Hull stays level.
Sail a little fuller and higher than idle_00. Hull stays level.
Sail flattened back toward the thrusters. Hull stays level.

attachments.note: Idle is a sail pose on a level hull. The sail foot is meant to stay on the rail. Exhaust is not in these frames.

frames.pose: Anticipation. Whole skiff banks nose-up, teeth stay closed, sail rakes back.
Active slash. Whole skiff banks nose-down, glass teeth open into the bite, sail swings toward the prow.
Recovery. Skiff settles near level with the teeth closing and the sail returning toward its rest rake.

events.name: slash
events.note: Intended contact at the start of the active frame. This does not change gameplay timing.

attachments.note: The bank is baked into the sprite around the canvas center. Thruster nozzles stay on the stern. No exhaust plume and no motion trail are baked in.

identityDrift: Every frame is a redraw guided by the canonical PNG, then keyed. Contours are softer than the hard-edged source, and glass-plate cracks, tooth spacing, and skull knots are not pixel-identical.
Idle hull correlation against the canonical lower hull is about 0.98, and the opaque left edge stays near x=73 versus the canonical x=75. The hull was not recentered.

Idle sail tips, topmost rose pixel: canonical (711, 251), idle_00 (663, 228), idle_01 (655, 217), idle_02 (478, 386). The ease-to-billow step is small. The rake-back flattens the sail and is the obvious pose.

Dash redraws the whole skiff, so plate patterns drift more. dash_00 is a clear nose-up load (opaque centroid y 573.6 versus the canonical 619.6). dash_01 is a clear nose-down bite; its opaque centroid is (525.8, 514.2) because the mass rotates, and the frame was not recentered onto the bounding box. dash_02 settles to (541.8, 606.9).

Facing stays left. No second sail, no mirrored prow, no lettering, no baked exhaust. Two thrusters remain. The open bite in dash_01 changes tooth spacing and can merge or split teeth relative to the canonical row.
Opaque bounds stay inside the 1024 canvas on every frame. Nothing was auto-cropped.
remainingWork: Not packed and not wired into NovaWing. Hand off to skills/enemy-animation-integrator.
Previewed offline at about 131 px canvas width on light and dark. Not verified in the running game.
The idle loop seam from rake-back to the next ease is abrupt. In-betweens would smooth it.
Dash recovery is a smaller pose change than the slash. Plate and tooth identity on the banked frames still drifts from the canonical drawing.
